title: Cache the account list Future instead of constructing it fresh inside AccountPickerScreen.build()
why: registry.getAllAccounts() is called directly inside `Widget build()`, which returns a brand-new Future object on every rebuild. FutureBuilder tracks futures by identity, so any unrelated rebuild of this ConsumerWidget (a ref.watch(accountDbFileNameProvider) change from switching accounts, a locale/theme change, or any ancestor rebuild) restarts the FutureBuilder into ConnectionState.waiting — flashing the loading spinner over the already-rendered account list and re-querying the device registry — the textbook 'Future-in-build' Flutter anti-pattern.
recommendation: Hoist the fetch behind a FutureProvider/AsyncNotifier (e.g. deviceAccountsProvider watched via ref.watch), or convert to ConsumerStatefulWidget and cache the Future in State so its identity is stable across rebuilds.
acceptance_criteria: A widget test triggers an unrelated provider rebuild while AccountPickerScreen is mounted and asserts the list does not revert to the loading spinner and getAllAccounts() is not invoked a second time
